title: autopilot-status
description: What `orch conduct autopilot status --json` prints: the state of the autopilot of the project (autopilot.json, records/v1 autopilot-state), whether a controller holds autopilot.lock, and a request it has not read yet.

status.description: none (no session yet), running, paused, draining, stopped, or dead (a session that did not stop and whose controller no longer holds the lock).

state.description: autopilot.json as written (records/v1 autopilot-state), null when there is none.

request.description: autopilot.request.json not read yet (records/v1 autopilot-request), null when there is none.
